name: @psyb0t/flickies
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted flickies video API over MCP — lipsync, face restore, and ffmpeg video ops as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running flickies instance's MCP endpoint (/v1/mcp), exposing its 11 tools: lipsync a face to audio, restore faces (GFPGAN), run ffmpeg ops (trim / concat / transcode / scale / mux_audio / extract_audio / thumbnail_grid), and probe metadata (ffprobe). flickies is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-flickies.

FLICKIES_URL.description: Base URL of your running flickies server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /v1/mcp).

FLICKIES_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the flickies server was started with FLICKIES_AUTH_TOKEN set.

url.description: Base URL of your running flickies server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /v1/mcp).

authToken.description: Bearer token, only if the flickies server was started with FLICKIES_AUTH_TOKEN set.
